units.source_text: 我一向叫他“先生”，所以此文中也这般称呼，

en.t: I always called him Sensei, so I will call him that in this account as well,

units.source_text: 而不公开他的姓名，这样对我来说更自然些，并非顾忌人言。

en.t: and I will not reveal his real name. This feels more natural to me, not because I am worried about what people may say.

units.source_text: 每当回想起他的音容笑貌，我便情不自禁地想叫一声“先生”，

en.t: Whenever I remember his voice, his face, and his smile, I cannot help wanting to call him Sensei,

units.source_text: 拿起笔来时，心情亦然，我实在不愿使用那种生分的姓氏缩写。

en.t: and I feel the same when I take up my pen. I truly do not want to use that distant abbreviation of his surname.

units.source_text: 我认识先生是在镰仓，当时我还是个少不更事的学生。

en.t: I met Sensei in Kamakura, when I was still an inexperienced student.

units.source_text: 趁着暑期去了海滨浴场的一个朋友，给我寄来明信片，邀我一定去玩，于是，我决定筹钱前往。

en.t: A friend who had gone to the seaside during summer vacation sent me a postcard urging me to come, so I decided to raise the money and go.

units.source_text: 我用了两三天的工夫筹钱，

en.t: It took me two or three days to get the money together,

units.source_text: 谁知在镰仓待了不到三天，邀我去的朋友突然接到乡下来的电报，让他马上回去。

en.t: but before I had spent even three days in Kamakura, the friend who had invited me suddenly received a telegram from home telling him to return at once.

units.source_text: 尽管电报上说他母亲病了，可是我那位朋友并不相信，

en.t: Although the telegram said that his mother was ill, my friend did not believe it,

units.source_text: 因为老家的父母早已给朋友包办了一门亲事。

en.t: because his parents back home had already arranged a marriage for him.

units.source_text: 可是，按现代人的习惯来说，他还不到谈婚论嫁的年龄，而且最关键的是，女方本人他没看上眼。

en.t: But by modern standards he was still too young to be talking about marriage, and most importantly, he did not like the woman herself.

units.source_text: 所以，暑假本应回家的，他却故意跑到东京附近游玩来了。

en.t: So although he was supposed to go home for summer vacation, he had deliberately gone off to amuse himself near Tokyo instead.

units.source_text: 他把电报拿给我看，问我该怎么办。

en.t: He showed me the telegram and asked what he should do.

units.source_text: 我也不知道该怎么办，如果他母亲真的病了，他当然应该回去。

en.t: I did not know what he should do either. If his mother really was ill, of course he ought to go home.

units.source_text: 最终他还是回去了，如此这般，特意赶到这里的我就落了单。

en.t: In the end he went back, and so I, who had gone to all that trouble to come there, was left alone.
